title: DigQDA — Digital QDA (AI-assisted): evidence-bound qualitative data analysis with local models
description: An open, versioned method-contract toolkit for evidence-bound qualitative data analysis (QDA) with local language models. The model proposes; deterministic code verifies. Human-in-the-loop analytic operations with an explicit method claim, a strict output schema, external quote/locator validation, and fail-closed semantics. This record archives a tagged source release; it contains software and no research data.
